payload.note: [llm audit] A static 0 K E(V) scan with a BM3 fit on the 8-atom diamond-cubic Si cell is the correct method for a lattice constant, and MACE-MPA-0 is being used inside its inorganic-crystal training domain. The value was cross-checked against other EOS forms, fit windows, a full cell relaxation and a 64-atom supercell, and the residual pressure at the minimum is near zero, so the 0.001 A numerical uncertainty is supported. The note correctly attributes the +0.66% offset from the CODATA value to the PBE-level training data rather than to the method, and states that zero-point and thermal corrections were omitted. No MD, transport or unit issues apply. [claude-opus-5-5, $0.0147]
